info.title: LMS Job Portal Service
info.description: Employers, jobs and hiring: company verification, jobs with eligibility rules and a hiring-pipeline template, eligibility-first matching with an explanation, recommendations, applications with a frozen resume, AI screening that only recommends, confirmed rejection batches, assessment and interview stages, offers, placement drives and institution placement views.

get.summary: My company's profile and its verification status
get.description: A company's jobs go live only while `status` is `verified`. The first call creates an empty `draft`.

post.summary: Apply to a job with one of my resumes
post.description: Needs a verified skill profile (`409 PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED`), the job's eligibility rules (`403 NOT_ELIGIBLE`, with the reasons), and an open job before its deadline. The resume is frozen at this moment: later edits never change what the recruiter sees. One application per job (`409 ALREADY_APPLIED`).

ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus
ApplicationStatus.description: applied → ai_screened → shortlisted | rejected → assessment → interview → review → offer → placed (docs/PRODUCT.md §5.7).

min_percent.title: Min Percent
min_percent.description: Below this, the candidate is flagged for the recruiter (never rejected automatically)

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Or: everyone still undecided whose screening score is at least this

CandidateJobOut.title: CandidateJobOut
CandidateJobOut.description: A job as a student sees it: with whether they may apply and why not, and their match.

institution_ids.title: Institution Ids
institution_ids.description: Empty: open to every institution. Otherwise the job is restricted to these institutions' students

EmployerJobOut.title: EmployerJobOut
EmployerJobOut.description: What the employer's own team (and a careers manager) sees: the full rules, the review note, the counts.

EmployerStatus.title: EmployerStatus
EmployerStatus.description: An employer's company profile is verified by a platform admin before any of its jobs can go live (docs/PRODUCT.md §5.7).

message.title: Message
examples: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +919876543210

InstitutionApplicationOut.title: InstitutionApplicationOut
InstitutionApplicationOut.description: What an institution's staff see about their students' applications: who, where, and how far. No screening, no notes.

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description: Any subset of the job's fields. A job that is pending approval cannot be edited (withdraw the submission first).

total_is_exact.title: Total Is Exact
total_is_exact.description: False when more records match than were counted

PipelineIn.title: PipelineIn
PipelineIn.description: Which optional stages this job uses. A stage that is on cannot be skipped; one that is off cannot be entered.

open_to_work.title: Open To Work
open_to_work.description: false: no recommendations and no match notifications

note.title: Note
note.default: These are recommendations. Nobody is shortlisted or rejected until a person does it.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. A person confirms every rejection; the AI's recommendation never rejects anyone
